projects.title: PMO Capital Portfolio Dashboard
projects.description: A SAP-integrated Power BI dashboard tracking a PKR 5.73 billion capital portfolio across 372 active projects for university leadership.
projects.problem: Leadership had no unified view of a PKR 5.73 billion capital portfolio spanning 372 active projects — data lived separately across SAP ERP, Smartsheet, and Oracle HIMS, and monthly KPI reporting relied on ~20 hours of manual Excel consolidation.
projects.solution: Architected a live Power BI dashboard integrating SAP ERP at WBS and purchase-order granularity with Smartsheet and Oracle HIMS via API, built on a star-schema data model as the single source of truth. Designed a KPI governance framework across 13 strategic objectives (Financial, Stakeholder, Employee Development, Compliance) covering 20+ metrics with monthly variance analysis.
projects.impact: Cut monthly KPI reporting effort by 70% (~20 hours to ~6 hours), reached ≥97% data accuracy and ≥80% management adoption, and became the tool university leadership uses directly for multi-billion PKR capital allocation decisions.

projects.title: Hospital-Wide KPI Dashboard Suite
projects.description: A suite of hospital-wide and departmental Power BI dashboards tracking 20+ clinical, operational, and administrative KPIs.
projects.problem: Departments (RHS, Pharmacy, FMSD, and others) reported KPIs inconsistently, with no single hospital-wide view of clinical, operational, and administrative performance for leadership.
projects.solution: Built a hospital-wide KPI dashboard plus dedicated departmental dashboards, integrating SAP ERP, Smartsheet API, and Oracle HIMS data pipelines, with weekly executive reports automated via Power Query M. Converted the RHS Revenue Dashboard to Looker Studio with automated refresh.
projects.impact: Reached ≥97% data accuracy with 100% monthly update compliance, cut departmental manual reporting by ≥30% with stakeholder feedback ≥4/5, and hit a ≥90% dashboard delivery rate on Looker Studio conversions.

projects.title: ERP-Integrated Real-Time KPI Monitoring
projects.description: Live Power BI dashboards wired directly into ERP APIs, replacing manual Excel-based KPI tracking across 20+ departments.
projects.problem: 20+ departments relied on manually prepared Excel reports for daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual KPI tracking, creating reporting delays and inconsistent numbers.
projects.solution: Integrated live Power BI dashboards with ERP APIs enabling 5-minute automated data refresh, and built PMO and performance-monitoring dashboards with further API integrations. Applied advanced SQL and ETL for multi-source data integration across operational and financial systems.
projects.impact: Eliminated manual report preparation across 20+ departments, lifted team productivity by 20%, cut the reporting backlog by 15%, and reached 95%+ KPI accuracy.

projects.title: HMIS Implementation & BI Rollout

projects.title: Enterprise EMR Rollout Across 14+ Departments

projects.title: Organization Expense Management Dashboard — Multi-Site KPI Tracking
projects.description: Live expense monitoring dashboard tracking 5 years of organizational expenses across 4 Major Organization sites, benchmarked against revenue — SAP API integration, daily refresh, and full cross-filter interactivity.
projects.problem: A multi-site healthcare organization required real-time visibility into organizational expenses across 4 Major Organization sites — covering direct, indirect, and allocation expense categories against monthly targets. Manual reporting through SAP extracts caused delays and limited leadership's ability to act on budget variances in time.
projects.solution: Built a comprehensive expense monitoring dashboard integrating live SAP ERP data via API with Smartsheet target data in Power BI. The dashboard tracks 5 years of organizational expense data, growing and updating automatically. Key features include KPI cards showing actual vs. target with utilization percentages across total, direct, indirect, and allocation expenses — each category also benchmarked against gross revenue (Expense vs. Revenue %) for a complete financial efficiency view; monthly expense trend analysis with target vs. actual comparison; top expenses by unit head with a live search box for specific head filtering; full cross-filter interactivity where clicking any bar or expense head filters all other visuals simultaneously; and hospital/expense-type slicers for site-level and category-level drill-down. Deployed on Power BI Service with a dedicated app, daily automated refresh, 5-year archived data, and 20-day incremental refresh logic.
projects.impact: Tracks PKR 5.78 billion in total expenses in real time across 4 Major Organization sites (PKR 2.12 billion in the current financial year alone), with direct, indirect, and allocation KPIs visible against target at every level. Leadership now identifies overspending unit heads instantly via live search and cross-filtering, and manual SAP extraction for monthly expense reporting has been eliminated entirely.

projects.title: Pharmacy Financial KPI Dashboard — Multi-Site Revenue & Profitability Tracking
projects.description: Live pharmacy financial dashboard tracking gross revenue, operating profit, and net income across 3 hospital sites — REST API integration, 4-hour refresh, and full interactive filtering.
projects.problem: Hospital pharmacy leadership required real-time financial visibility across 3 sites — tracking gross revenue, operating profit, and net income against monthly targets. Manual reporting cycles caused significant delays, meaning by the time financial results reached top management, the numbers were already outdated.
projects.solution: Built a comprehensive pharmacy financial KPI dashboard integrating live POS transaction data via REST API with Google Sheets target data in Power BI. The dashboard tracks gross revenue, operating profit, and net income with target vs. actual comparisons across all 3 sites. Key features include KPI cards showing gross revenue, operating profit, and net income — each with achievement percentage and actual vs. target ratio; monthly revenue trend with target line and actual expense overlay on hover; OPD and IPD revenue breakdown with target vs. actual donut charts; revenue by hospital site comparison; and full cross-filter interactivity across all visuals. A collapsible filter panel includes site selection and a custom date calendar with year, quarter, and month views, enabling leadership to compare performance across any time period. Deployed on Power BI Service with a dedicated app, 4-hour incremental refresh, and 5-year archived data.
projects.impact: Gross revenue target achieved at 100.02% (PKR 197.96M vs. PKR 197.91M target), with operating profit (PKR 62.44M, 31.54% of revenue) and net income (PKR 49.97M, 25.24% of revenue) tracked against targets across all 3 sites. OPD and IPD revenue are monitored separately with utilization percentages, and manual financial reporting cycles have been eliminated entirely — top management and pharmacy heads now access validated live financials instead of delayed manual reports.

projects.title: Healthcare Executive Analytics Dashboard | KPI & Performance Insights
projects.description: Interactive healthcare executive analytics solution consolidating financial, patient, operational, and quality data into one management reporting experience, refreshed every 5 hours.
projects.problem: Hospital leadership relied on multiple disconnected departmental dashboards and reports, with no single consolidated executive view of real-time performance across financial, patient, operational, and quality metrics — creating fragmented insight and manual effort to piece together the full picture.
projects.solution: Designed an interactive healthcare executive analytics solution consolidating financial, patient, operational, and quality data into a unified management reporting experience, using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling. Provides KPI monitoring, revenue and budget analysis, hospital comparison, department and consultant performance, patient-flow analysis, and quality and safety indicators — transforming operational data into actionable management insights. Refreshes every 5 hours, with 5 years of archived data and a 10-day incremental refresh window. The portfolio version uses anonymized/synthetic data to demonstrate the reporting approach while protecting confidential information.
projects.impact: Replaced multiple disconnected departmental dashboards and reports with a single real-time executive view, refreshed every 5 hours against 5 years of archived history. Leadership can compare hospital performance, analyze department and consultant productivity, monitor patient flow, and review quality and safety indicators from one consolidated source — turning operational data into decisions instead of manual report compilation.
